account.title: Account security
account.intro: Your password and the devices signed in to the administration. If in doubt (lost computer, sign-in you do not recognise), change your password: all other devices are signed out.
account.interfaceLangHelp: The language of the menus, buttons and messages in the administration and the editor. It does not change the content of the site: you keep writing in French and English as before.
account.langFailed: The language could not be changed. Try again.
account.passwordDisabled: Password sign-in is turned off on this site: you sign in with Authentik, where your password is changed.
account.accountIntro: Account: <mono>{email}</mono>. Changing the password signs out all other devices (this session stays open).
account.newPasswordHelp: At least {min} characters; a phrase of several words is safer and easier to remember.
account.passwordFailed: The password could not be changed. Try again.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. All other devices are signed out.
account.sessionsHelp: A session expires after {idle} days without use, and {max} days at the latest after it was opened: you then have to sign in again.
account.revokeTitle: {count, plural, one {Sign out # other session?} other {Sign out # other sessions?}}
account.revokeBody: The other devices will have to sign in again. This session stays open. If you do not recognise a sign-in, change your password too.
account.revokeFailed: The other sessions could not be signed out. Try again.
account.revoked: {count, plural, one {# other session signed out.} other {# other sessions signed out.}}
account.revokedNone: No other session to sign out.

backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: The site automatically keeps copies of your work. Here you can see the copies made, make one whenever you like, and download one to your computer.
backups.reason_delai: Changes had been waiting too long (you were still working)
backups.downloadFailed: The download could not be prepared. Try again.
backups.advice: Keep a copy on your computer from time to time: backups are stored in the same place as your site. They protect you from a slip-up, not from losing the disk. Download the latest one now and then.
backups.alert: Warning: {message} It was due on {date}. Make a backup by hand (button below) and tell the person who looks after the site: the site log contains a “[backup] ALERTE” line with the details.
backups.retentionText: The last {keep}, plus the last one of each of the past {days} days (Paris time). The rest is deleted at the next backup.
backups.delayLabel: Backup even while you are working
backups.delayText: At most every {maxHours} h when changes are waiting (otherwise after {quietMin} min without changes).
backups.writing: Writing the archive: {done, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} of {total}
backups.missing: Warning: {count, plural, one {# file used by your site is not in the latest backup and cannot be recreated} other {# files used by your site are not in the latest backup and cannot be recreated}} (for example <mono>{samples}</mono>). Upload these images again (or remove them from the site); otherwise they will be broken after a restore.
backups.oldBackup: Old: without the kit drawings, imported frames or icons.
backups.unlockBody: A backup contains the whole site database. Type your password again: downloads stay unlocked for 10 minutes.
backups.includeMediaHelp: Without them, the copy is much lighter, but it only protects the text and the layout.
backups.keepHelp: The latest backups (“recent”). On top of these comes the last one of each of the past {days} days (“daily”, a server setting, BACKUP_KEEP_DAYS). The rest is deleted at the next backup. Always kept as well: the most recent one older than 48 hours and the last 3 made with “Back up now” (counted separately).
backups.quietLabel: Minutes without changes before backing up
backups.maxLabel: Maximum hours before backing up your changes, even if you are still working

cardSettings.title: Section cards
cardSettings.intro: A block can sit on a coloured card (“Background” button on the page). This is what it gets when the card is turned on with nothing else chosen. Blocks without a card do not change.
cardSettings.colorHelp: A theme colour or a soft shade follows palette changes.
cardSettings.textOk: The text reads well on this card.
cardSettings.textBad: The text is hard to read on this colour ({ratio}:1, 4.5:1 is needed).
cardSettings.borderAuto: Default: the colour of the card's text
cardSettings.borderHelp: The border follows the card's corners; thin, medium or thick. With no colour chosen, it takes the colour of the card's text, always legible on it.

common.unsavedLeave: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page without saving them?

cursorSettings.title: Mouse cursors
cursorSettings.systemHelp: The system cursors. To draw your own: group “9 · Cursor” of the Photoshop kit (normal, and when hovering what can be clicked).
cursorSettings.useDrawn: Use the drawn cursors on the site
cursorSettings.useDrawnHelp: Unticked: the system cursors; your drawings are kept. On the public site only (not in the administration); text fields keep their text cursor.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your site at a glance: how it looks online and what it contains.
dashboard.noActiveTheme: No valid active theme: the site is using the default look.
dashboard.newMessages: {count, plural, =0 {No new messages} one {# new message} other {# new messages}}

diagnostic.title: Diagnostics
diagnostic.intro: What the site sees of your connection. The IP used should be yours (not a proxy's): it is what limits sign-in attempts. If it is not, adjust AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS (the number of trusted proxies in front of the site).
diagnostic.redirectedDomains: Domains redirected to the main address (REDIRECT_FROM)

favicon.mode_auto_help: Your logo if you have one, otherwise a monogram: your initials, in your heading font and your theme's colours. It changes along with your theme.
favicon.mode_image_help: An image from your media library, cropped to a square.
favicon.mode_kit_help: You draw it in the “Icône” layer of the Photoshop kit (group “4 · Icône”). With no drawing, the automatic icon is used.
favicon.tabAlt_dark: Icon at actual size (16 pixels), dark tab
favicon.tabAlt_light: Icon at actual size (16 pixels), light tab
favicon.tabCaption_dark: Dark tab · actual size and enlarged
favicon.tabCaption_light: Light tab · actual size and enlarged
favicon.saved: Icon saved · visible across the whole site
favicon.howHelp: The small image next to the site name in the browser tab, and on a phone's home screen.
favicon.imageHelp: A square image gives the best result. Otherwise, you choose the part to keep.
favicon.lettersEmpty: Empty: the initials of your name.
favicon.previewTitle: This is how the icon will look (with the live theme)
favicon.phoneAlt: Icon on a phone's home screen
favicon.logoTooWide: Your logo is too wide for such a small icon: the monogram is used instead.

fields.pageIsCollectionHelp: The automatic entries on the home page follow the pages that have a collection. A collection has only one page{taken, plural, =0 {} other { (already taken: {list})}}.
fields.picker_image_help: Choose an image from the media library, or upload a new one.
fields.picker_video_help: Choose a video from the media library, or upload a new one.
fields.picker_pdf_help: Choose a PDF from the media library, or upload a new one.
fields.suggestions: {count, plural, =0 {No suggestions} one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}}
fields.wpHelp: “Same as the site”: nothing changes. “None” or a wallpaper replaces the site wallpaper on this page only.
fields.wpEmpty: There are no wallpapers in the library: import some in “Themes” → “Wallpapers”.
fields.wpGone: This wallpaper is no longer in the library: the page no longer shows one. Choose another.
fields.btnHelp: A different color for the buttons and links of this page only. The other pages keep the site's “{role}” color.
fields.btnPickerLabel: Color of the page's buttons and links
fields.btnWarning: Readability: insufficient. This color is still applied; it may make buttons or links hard to read.
fields.btnFix: Adjust to the nearest shade that passes

firstSteps.title: Getting started
firstSteps.theme_text: The theme sets the colors, fonts and mood of your whole site.
firstSteps.project_title: Create a project and add images
firstSteps.project_text: A project gathers your images. Images you upload from a project are added to it directly.
firstSteps.page_text: A project is only visible if a page displays it: add a “Project” block to a page.
firstSteps.publish_text: Until a page is published, nobody can see it on your site.
firstSteps.about_text: Your name, your introduction and your email address, so people can get in touch.

fonts.title: Downloaded fonts
fonts.summary: {count} / {max} fonts · {used} of {limit}. A font chosen in the editor is downloaded by the site; those no longer in use are removed on publishing, or here.
fonts.none: No downloaded fonts: the texts use the theme's fonts.
fonts.deleteBody: Its files are erased from the site. You will be able to choose it again in the editor (it will be downloaded again).

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.text: This action is reserved for signed-in administrators. Your session may have expired.

frames.name: Name
frames.detected: The edge was detected automatically. Adjust the thickness if you want it thinner or wider.
frames.notDetected: I could not detect the edge (the file has no transparency in the middle): a medium thickness is used, adjust it with the slider.
frames.usedBy: {count, plural, one {Used by # image} other {Used by # images}}
frames.badFormat: “{name}”: a frame must be a PNG or a WebP on a transparent background, or an SVG.
frames.deletedWithImages: Deleted · “{name}” ({count, plural, one {# image goes back} other {# images go back}} to “None”)
frames.dropHere: Drop your frames here, or choose them
frames.dropHelp: PNG or WebP on a transparent background, or SVG. The edge is detected automatically.
frames.themeFrameHelp: The frame drawn in the Photoshop kit of your live theme. It changes by importing a new kit; you can pick it for each image like the others.
frames.empty: No frame imported yet. Import your first frame above.
frames.deleteUses: {count, plural, one {This frame is used by # image. It goes back} other {This frame is used by # images. They go back}} to “None”: nothing else changes.
frames.deleteUnused: This frame is not used anywhere.

guide.changedCount: {count, plural, =0 {no settings changed} one {# setting changed} other {# settings changed}}
guide.textIntro: Choose the font for your headings and for your text. The rest sets itself.
guide.airHelp: The colour placed behind a heading or a text (Banner, Highlight): tight against the letters, or with more room. Each text can pick its own.
guide.textAdvancedHint: The caption font, then the style of each text on the site (font, weight, italics, letter case, letter spacing).
guide.captionsHelp: Labels and captions of the works.
guide.paperIntro: Choose the background of your pages, then the space between blocks.
guide.wallpaperHint: My wallpaper: your drawn patterns, to repeat behind a page, a large block or the cards. You pick them from the page, block or card concerned.
guide.drawHint: You can also draw your own paper in Photoshop (“Draw in Photoshop”, at the top of the page): it will appear here with its settings.
guide.spacingHelp: The space between sections and at the sides of the pages.
guide.spacingPrecise: This theme has precise spacing (fine-tuned below), close to “{label}”. It is kept as it is: choose a level to replace it.
guide.spacingAdvancedHint: The spacing in rem and the maximum width of the content.
guide.betweenSectionsHelp: On a large screen; halved on mobile.
guide.shapesIntro: Choose the shape of the site's elements, then how round the corners are.
guide.noLayers: This theme has no layers: the “Layered depth” opening shows without any depth.
guide.roundHelp: A single setting for the corners of buttons, cards, blocks and images: from square to very round.
guide.roundPrecise: This theme has precise roundness (fine-tuned below), close to “{label}”. It is kept as it is: choose a step to replace it.
guide.roundAdvancedHint: The corner radii one by one, in pixels, and the shape of the buttons.
guide.imageFailed: “{name}”: the image could not be prepared.
guide.logoImported: Logo imported: it keeps its colours. Save to keep it.
guide.logoIntro: Your logo replaces your name written at the top left of every page.
guide.noLogo: No logo yet: your name is written as text in the header. Import an image, or draw your logo in Photoshop.
guide.drawInPhotoshop: Draw it in Photoshop → open the kit
guide.removeLogo: Remove the logo (go back to the written name)
guide.logoFormatHelp: PNG or WebP on a transparent background, cropped close to the drawing: that looks best.
guide.keepColorsHelp: The logo is shown as it was drawn or imported.
guide.useTextColorHelp: Only the shape is kept: the logo is drawn like your text, in its colour.
guide.lostColors: A logo saved before this version may have lost its colours: import it again to get them back.
guide.cursorHint: The mouse cursor is also drawn in the Photoshop kit.

journal.title: Journal
journal.intro: Everything that was changed on the site: when, from which page, with what result. Errors seen in your browser are in here too. Entries are kept for 30 days (20,000 lines at most). No password, email address or image content is ever written to it.
journal.optNoPage: Not on a page (settings, themes, media library…)

kit.emptyFile: “{name}” is empty: choose the right file.
kit.uploadIntro: Send the finished kit: the .zip archive, or one or more .psd files chosen together (saved from Photoshop, as they are). You can send just one part (the file downloaded as “one part only”) or only the files you changed: the rest of the kit does not change.
kit.importRunning: Import in progress: reading the layers, converting the redrawn elements…
kit.importQueued: Import queued (a video conversion may be in progress)…
kit.targetNone: The kit applies to: My theme
kit.targetHelpMine: Only the elements you redrew change; the rest of My theme is kept as it is. Nothing goes online until you publish.
kit.targetHelpNone: You do not have a My theme yet: it is created from “{basedOn}” (version 1), then your kit makes it version 2.
kit.versionCreatedToast: Version {version} of My theme created: preview it, then publish
kit.useMirror: Use the mirror image of your {from} for the {to}
kit.applyColors: {count, plural, one {Apply the repainted colour} other {Apply the # repainted colours}}
kit.applyIntro: Adds a new version (version {version}) to “{themeName}” with {what, select, many {the {changed} redrawn elements} one {the redrawn element} colors {your colours} other {the redrawn elements}}{andColors, select, yes { and your colours} other {}}. The live theme does not change until you publish, and you can always go back to the previous version.{mineCreated, select, no { My theme is created first (version 1) from the theme this kit came from.} other {}}
kit.tapeNote: The tape is redrawn: the new version turns on the “taped” variant of the boards (remove it in the editor if you do not want it).
kit.alreadyApplied: Already applied{hasVersion, select, yes { (version {version})} other {}}: <link>see My theme</link>.
kit.backToThemes: Version created: going back to the Themes screen…
kit.creatingWait: Creating version {version}: a few seconds, please stay on the page.

kitDownload.queued: Kit queued (a video conversion may be in progress)…
kitDownload.tooLong: Preparing the kit is taking too long: try again in a moment.
kitDownload.partsHelp: Each part is a single .psd file, identical to the one in the full kit (same layers, same names). Send it back as it is: only that part is updated, the others stay as they are.
kitDownload.partsGen: Kit generation: {s} s (once, then each part downloads right away).
kitDownload.partsWeights: The size of each part is shown once the kit is generated.

kitPage.title: Photoshop kit
kitPage.currentKept: The theme's current element is kept.
kitPage.intro: Download the kit, paint in Photoshop what you want to change, then send the file back: each element is checked and you choose what to apply.
kitPage.exportHelp: The kit reflects the saved state of this theme: one group per element, with where it appears on the site and the instructions.
kitPage.nothingToCheck: No element to check in this file: nothing was recognised, the theme stays as it is.
kitPage.foreign: This kit comes from the theme “{from}”, not from “{name}” (the screen where you sent it): it is applied to My theme, and only the redrawn elements change.
kitPage.referenceKnown: Original kit recognised ({how, select, id {file identifier} other {layer contents}}): whatever has not moved is kept as it is.
kitPage.referenceUnknown: Original kit not recognised: every element is imported.
kitPage.decor: Home decor: {count, plural, one {# layer read} other {# layers read}} (from the farthest to the front){ref, select, same {, same composition as the exported kit} changed {, composition changed (the exported kit had {previous})} other {}}.
kitPage.decorFix: A layer needs fixing: the current decor is kept in the meantime.
kitPage.fileNoChange: No element of this file changes: the theme's own are kept.
kitPage.colorsCount: {read, plural, one {# swatch read} other {# swatches read}}: {changed} repainted, {unchanged} unchanged{missing, plural, =0 {} one {, # unreadable} other {, # unreadable}}{ignored, plural, =0 {} one {, # layer ignored} other {, # layers ignored}}.
kitPage.colorsWarning: Warning: once applied, some colours will make text hard to read ({list}). They will be applied anyway; you can fix them in Photoshop or untick them.
kitPage.noSwatchPainted: No repainted swatch detected: the theme's colours stay as they are (“auto” shades follow their base). To change a colour, paint the swatch itself (brush, paint bucket, or a layer added in “8 · Palette” on top), then save the .psd.
kitPage.colorsRepainted: {changed, plural, one {# colour repainted} other {# colours repainted}}; {unchanged} unchanged (an “auto” shade follows its base).
kitPage.colorsProblem: Insufficient legibility once applied ({first}): they will be applied anyway; you can fix them in Photoshop or untick them.

messages.intro: What visitors write to you from a contact form.
messages.noEmail: Messages arrive here. Remember to check in.

pageEditor.conflict: {message} Your fields stay displayed here: copy what you want to keep before reloading.
pageEditor.titleHelp: In the menu and at the top of the tab.
pageEditor.homeAddressHelp: Home page: its address is the root of the site and cannot be changed.
pageEditor.keepOldHelp: Links that have already been shared ({links}) redirect to the new address. If unticked, they will show “not found”.
pageEditor.onlineHelpHome: The home page always stays live.
pageEditor.onlineHelpLive: Visible to everyone. Untick to take the page off the site.
pageEditor.onlineHelpOff: Not live yet: the page answers “not found” to your visitors.
pageEditor.inMenuHelp: At the end of the menu; change the order from the list of pages.
pageEditor.seoTitleHelp: Empty: the page title is used.
pageEditor.descriptionHelp: One or two sentences shown under the link in search results.
pageEditor.shareImageHelp: Shown when this page's link is shared. Empty: the first image of the page, otherwise your site's image (Settings).
pageEditor.contentCount: This page is made up of {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}.
pageEditor.contentIntro: {summary} The content is built in the visual editor: you add, move and delete blocks there, and adjust each one directly on the page.
pageEditor.blockProblem: A block is preventing saving: fix it in the editor.
pageEditor.editContent: Edit the content in the editor
pageEditor.noteDirty: The preview shows the saved version: save first.
pageEditor.noteLive: Page is live. “Save” only changes this information: the content is published with “Publish” in the editor.
pageEditor.noteDraft: Page not live yet: only visible in preview. It goes live with “Publish” in the editor.
pageEditor.savedRedirect: Saved · the old address redirects to the new one
pageEditor.savedBroken: Saved · old links to this page will stop working
pageEditor.savedNotLive: Information saved · page not live yet

pagesMgr.title: Pages
pagesMgr.intro: Organise your site's pages: where they sit in the menu, their address in French and in English, and the blocks that make them up.
pagesMgr.projectsIntro: A project gathers your images on a board. It is visible on the site only if a page displays it. You can also create one directly on a page's canvas. Drag the cards to choose their order on the site.
pagesMgr.homeIntro: The home page of your site.
pagesMgr.draftCorrupt: This page's draft can no longer be read (a block has changed). Open the visual editor to start again from the live version before saving here.
pagesMgr.draftPending: This page has unpublished changes in the visual editor. “Save” here only changes the information: your content changes stay pending until “Publish”.
pagesMgr.createIntro: The page is created unpublished: you build it in the editor, then “Publish” in the editor puts it online.
pagesMgr.titleEnHelp: Optional: the French title is used otherwise.
pagesMgr.trashIntro: A deleted page is no longer on the site or in the menu. It stays here for {days} days: restore it in one click, after which it is erased for good.
pagesMgr.erasedIn: erased in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
pagesMgr.missingAlt: {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} without a description (for visually impaired people and Google). To be completed in the media library.
pagesMgr.notInMenuToast: This page is live but does not appear in any menu: use “Add to menu”.
pagesMgr.untranslatedToast: {label}: English-speaking visitors will see these passages empty or in French.
pagesMgr.menuHelp: Drag pages by their handle, or use the keyboard: Space to pick up, arrow keys to move, Space to drop.
pagesMgr.unpublishedChangesTitle: Changes made in the editor have not been published yet.
pagesMgr.toastOffline: “{title}” taken off the site: it is no longer visible
pagesMgr.toastLiveNoDraft: “{title}” is live, without its unpublished changes
pagesMgr.notInMenu: This page is live but does not appear in any menu
pagesMgr.specialsHelp: The site displays them itself: you build their content like a page's, but they have no menu entry and no address to share.
pagesMgr.specialOfflineTitle: The site goes back to the original error page.
pagesMgr.toastSpecialOffline: “{title}” taken off the site: the original error page is back
pagesMgr.blockedIntro: This page is used by {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}: remove these links before deleting it.
pagesMgr.deleteKeep: It leaves the site and the menu, but stays in the trash for {days} days: you can find it there again or undo right afterwards.
pagesMgr.draftKept: Its editor draft is kept; its unpublished changes to projects or to the header (social links, footer) are discarded.

palette.scrimBad: Text that is hard to read on the background of enlarged images: insufficient legibility.
palette.fixNearest: Adjust to the nearest shade that passes
palette.noNearTone: No nearby shade passes: also change the background colour concerned.
palette.sampleSoft: Secondary text, caption of a work.
palette.sampleScrim: Caption on the background of enlarged images
palette.intro: Six base colours and their shades. An “auto” shade follows its base colour; change it to pick it yourself. Each text must stay legible on each background (the exact ratio is in the tooltip). A red indicator warns you that a text will be hard to read, without stopping you from saving.
palette.scrimText: Text on the background of enlarged images

paperSettings.title: Drawn paper
paperSettings.underHeaderHelp: Unticked (default): the sticky banner at the top is a flat fill of the background colour, the tile covers the rest of the site. Ticked: the tile also goes behind the navigation.
paperSettings.onCardsHelp: Unticked (default): block cards are opaque flat fills that hide the paper. Ticked: the paper is drawn over each card's colour, under its content. Each card can keep its own choice (“Card” menu on the canvas: “Like the site”, “Under the card” or “On the card”).

photoFrame.title: Theme frame on all photos
photoFrame.help: Your theme draws a frame. On “No”, your photos do not have one: you add it photo by photo, with the “Frame” button in an image's toolbar. On “Yes”, all the photos with no choice made get it.

projectEditor.title: Title
projectEditor.contextHelp: Type of project and your role (e.g. Short film · Character design).
projectEditor.legacyFeatured: Featured in the old “Featured projects” block
projectEditor.legacyFeaturedHelp: This old block, still present on {pages}, shows the projects ticked here first. “Project” blocks ignore this setting.
projectEditor.dropHere: Drop an image here, or drag one in from the Library
projectEditor.slotTitleHelp: Shown under the image and in the viewer. With no title, only the year is shown.
projectEditor.collectionHelp: The shelf this image is filed under: it appears on that collection's page, and the home page tile counts it.
projectEditor.coverHelp: This image illustrates the “{name}” tile on the home page (“Collection entries” block). If several images are ticked, the first one in the collection is used; if none is ticked, the first image of the collection is used.

projects.blockedIntro: This project is displayed by {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}: remove it from these blocks before deleting it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your site's identity: your name, what you do, the address people can write to you at, and your social links. Here, a change goes live as soon as you save; in the editor, the same fields are published with the page you publish.
settings.journalAsk: Need to know what was changed, when, and from which page?
settings.draftPending: Site changes are waiting in the editor.
settings.draftBody: The menu, header, footer or styles have been changed there but are not live yet: they will go live when you publish any page. The fields below already show what is pending for the name, role, email, credit line and social links: saving them here puts them live right away. The other pending changes (menu, styles, logo) stay as they are.
settings.saved: Saved · visible across the whole site
settings.siteNameHelp: At the top of every page and in the browser tab. If left empty in English, the French name is used.
settings.contactHelp: The “Write” buttons open an email to this address.
settings.roleHelp: Under your name (e.g. Illustrator & character designer).
settings.socialsHelp: Shown in the footer and on the About page, in this order.
settings.headerSocialsHelp: Right before the language switch (FR / EN), icons only; on a phone, inside the menu.

themeEditor.advancedHint: The other colours (block backgrounds, fine lines, hover, shadows…) are worked out from the four base colours. Change one to fix it; “Back to auto” hands it back to the calculation.
themeEditor.sitePaletteNotice: The site overrides {count, plural, one {a colour} other {some colours}} of this theme from the visual editor: {names}. They apply on top of this theme while it is online; the colours below remain those of the theme. To remove them: visual editor, the site's “Colours” panel, “Go back to the theme's colours”.

themes.title: Themes
themes.intro: Templates never change: you have a single theme of your own, “My theme”, which you develop version after version (colours, Photoshop kit, import). Only what is online is seen by your visitors: preview, then publish.
themes.noneBody: The site is shown with the default look. The supplied themes are installed the first time a new database starts.

edit.title: Edit a theme
edit.wallpapersIntro: Your drawn patterns, to repeat as a background: across a whole page, behind a large block, or on the cards. Import as many as you like (PNG or WebP on a transparent background).

versions.title: History of {name}
versions.intro: Each kit, import, template change or editing session adds a version. Going back to a version creates a new, identical one: nothing is lost. The last {count} versions are kept, along with the ones you star and the ones that have been online.

frames.title: Frames
frames.intro: Your drawn frames, to place around a photo or a video. Import as many as you like (PNG or WebP on a transparent background, or SVG), then pick one in the “Frame” menu of each image.

wallpapers.title: Wallpapers
wallpapers.intro: Your drawn patterns, to repeat as a background: across a whole page, behind a large component, or on the cards. Import as many as you like (PNG or WebP on a transparent background).

themeType.title: Styles by role
themeType.intro: Fine-tune the font, weight, italics, letter case and letter spacing of each text role. “Theme” keeps the original setting; site styles and the styles of one specific text always apply on top.

h1.title: Page title
h1.help: Only what differs from “Headings” for the main title of a page (leave “Theme” for it to follow the headings).

h2.title: Headings
h2.help: All the headings on the site: page title, sections, projects, collections.

caption.title: Captions
caption.help: Captions of the works, job title.

menu.title: Menu
menu.help: Navigation in the header and the footer.

brand.title: Logo
brand.help: Site name in the header, when there is no image.
